steps.message: On Mastodon, find lectures in the #openTalk hashtag for the current month, then add the lecture information (time, location, topic) to the calendar events. If the start time is within 10 days, set the reminder time to 1 day before. Otherwise, set the reminder time to 3 days before the start time.
